title: ResumeByAI
summary: A Next.js application that uses GPT-4 Turbo to generate ATS-oriented résumés and integrates Razorpay for paid access.
overview: ResumeByAI guides users through creating résumé content and uses GPT-4 Turbo to produce ATS-oriented output.
The application combines an AI generation workflow with Razorpay-based paid access.
problem: Writing clear, role-relevant résumé content is difficult, and users often do not know how to structure information for applicant-tracking systems.
solution: Collect guided user input, generate structured résumé content with GPT-4 Turbo, and provide access through an integrated payment workflow.
